messages.text: I will dictate the whole release procedure once, write it down exactly. First, before anything else, freeze the version file and print the git short SHA into the release notes header — that header is what support quotes back at us. Then check the migration ledger for anything applied in staging but not production, and write each missing migration's name on its own line in the notes. After that, build the changelog from the merge commits since the last tag — not the squash commits, the merge commits, because the squash ones lie about order. Actually — before the changelog, tag the freeze commit so the changelog script knows where to stop; I always forget that ordering matters here. Then verify the changelog mentions every migration you listed, and if one is missing, stop and ask, do not patch it by hand.
